title: Tarjan's deque conjecture for online binary search trees
statement: Let ${\mathcal{A}}$ be an online binary search tree algorithm. Starting with any initial tree $T$ with $n$ elements, consider inserting or deleting the current minimum or maximum elements $m$ times. **Deque conjecture.** The cost of these operations is $O(m+n)$. This is one of the classical conjectures about the efficiency of splay trees and online binary search trees; its status is not resolved in the supplied source.
source_name: Parinya Chalermsook, Mayank Goswami, Laszlo Kozma, Kurt Mehlhorn and Thatchaphol Saranurak, “Pattern-avoiding access in binary search trees”, arXiv:1507.06953 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1507.06953

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2015).
